comment:
* Encapsulates information about the optimizations performed on a dex file.
     *
     * Note that the info is only meant for debugging and is not guaranteed to be
     * stable across releases and/or devices.

variables.name: status
variables.comment: The human readable refined optimization status of the validity of the odex file.

variables.name: reason
variables.comment: the compiler artifacts were not annotated during optimizations.

methods.name: public String getStatus()
methods.comment:
* Returns the human readable refined status of the validity of the odex file.
         *
         * @return optimization status
         *
         * @hide

methods.name: public String getReason()
methods.comment:
* Returns the reason of a particular optimization used.
         *
         * @return optimization reason
         *
         * @hide

methods.name: public boolean isVerified()
methods.comment: * Returns whether the dex file is verified.

methods.name: public boolean isOptimized()
methods.comment:
* Returns whether the dex file is in an optimal state. Currently, this means the dex file
         * is either ahead-of-time compiled with a profile or fully ahead-of-time compiled.

methods.name: public boolean isFullyCompiled()
methods.comment: * Returns whether the dex file is fully ahead-of-time compiled.
